party_basis: the last party primary each voter voted in (2020-2026)
party_methods_note: Party (the last party primary each voter voted in) is shown for all ballots combined; it isn't split by voting method, so this view is turnout only.

party_hints.cast: Everyone who has voted so far, by the last party primary they voted in (2020-2026), as matched by theoelections.com from the counties' early-voting rosters. No party = no primary since 2020, including new voters.

unk_label: counted, but not yet on the rosters matched to primary history
map_note: In-person early votes for 8 counties (Bell, Dallas, Ellis, Hockley, Madison, McLennan, Montgomery, Travis) come from the county's own live turnout page (updated through the day). Harris's in-person early votes come from the county's own early-voting report, posted each voting evening (ahead of the state's next-morning figure). Every other county's come from the Secretary of State's daily report, which adds each day's in-person votes the next morning, so during the day those counties lag behind. Party is the last party primary each voter voted in (2020-2026), from theoelections.com's match of the counties' early-voting rosters to primary voting history (253 counties, 2,112,992 voters as of 2026-10-22); ballots not on those rosters yet, such as today's in-person votes, count as party not reported. Where the rosters count more mail or in-person voters than the state's report or a county's live page, the roster count is used for that method: Harris 324,414 (was 322,679), Dallas 209,959 (was 208,766), Tarrant 170,842 (was 113,462), Bexar 148,981 (was 86,447), Travis 131,391 (was 128,029), Collin 103,658 (was 85,180), Denton 98,950 (was 83,804), Williamson 74,764 (was 61,437).

source.primary: Texas Secretary of State, Election Information & Turnout Data (unofficial early voting turnout by county, as submitted by county election officials)

party_history.label: theoelections.com (early voters by last party primary)
